LESSON: SCALE DRAWING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry 4.1 Coordinates and Graphs (6 lessons) • Straight line graph • Parallel
Topic 4.2: Scale Drawing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Scale Drawing, part of Geometry 4.1 Coordinates and Graphs (6 lessons) • Straight line graph • Parallel in Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use scale drawing in real life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Scale Drawing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and Imagination: learner sketches and determines angles of elevation and depression.

● Citizenship: learner use scale drawing in simple surveying.

Values:
● Unity: learner sketches, discusses, and agrees on points in simple surveying.

● Social Cohesion: learner observes maps and watches videos on land surveying.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Learner discusses with others possible Careers in scale drawing and surveying.

Link to other Learning Areas: Social Studies help learners to work cooperatively with others to observe maps in surveying

and locating bearings.
